sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Dr. Nova, what is the critical industrial lesson from this case study?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Systems collapse when models mistake collection artifacts for real-world signals.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: In ICU sepsis models, observation frequency became a confounder; in autonomous robotics, a 50-millisecond timestamp jitter causes a 1.4-meter bounding box dislocation at highway speeds.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Dr. Nova, where should this defensive type-safe schema validation execute?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Always enforce schema contracts at the ingestion boundary before raw records enter memory.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Using Pydantic or zero-copy Arrow prevents unvalidated floats and untyped strings from silently polluting downstream tensors.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Dr. Nova, what is the single most vital principle for data engineers to remember from this lesson?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Data-Centric AI requires treating dataset curation with the exact same rigor, versioning, and defensive auditing as neural model code.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Fixing defects at the boundary guarantees downstream reliability.
